items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I heard talk of him. I never met him.

ctx.x: No, very, very seldom. Very seldom. In other words they didn't use accordion at all those things.
What about Peyton? Do you remember him?
I heard talk of him. I never met him. He was accordion prior. I can't remember too many of them.
